verdict.rationale: Supabase's official CLI explicitly documents running the entire stack locally or in CI (supabase-docs-21), and hands-on probes confirm the CLI installs and runs headlessly via npx and can scaffold a project with no login/keys (supabase-probe-6, supabase-probe-8), which is exactly the CI/automation use case. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow) or independent third-party CI report beyond the probe evidence.
